data.title: LeBron James sues makers of AI sports-betting app, saying they used his likeness and nickname
data.description: NBA superstar LeBron James has sued the makers of an AI sports-betting app, saying they deliberately violated his publicity rights and trademarks by calling it “Bron” and using artificially generated images of him in their marketing.
